owner: the CU-BUDGET lane. ONE file, ONE owner. A tier does not carry its own copy of a number that lives here; it carries a `cu-budget` witness naming its campaign, and the shared evaluator tools/gauntlet/tier1/check-witnesses.sh reads this file.
note: Checked-in per-transaction compute budgets for the golden transactions. A budget is a CEILING a campaign must stay under, evaluated against that campaign's own finalized evidence. Over budget is a red row naming the transaction and the delta. Read CU_BUDGETS.md before changing a number in here; in particular, read what it says about noise, because the numbers in this file are NOT deterministic and the tolerances are the whole reason the file is usable.

ceiling.provenance: Solana's per-transaction MAX_COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT. It is the chain's limit, not ours: a transaction that asks for more is refused at request time, and one that consumes it is refused at the ceiling with no partial result. Found31 died exactly this way before c61376d. Every `transaction`-scope budget in this file must be at or below it; a budget above the ceiling is refused by the evaluator, which is how this file says out loud that a transaction has stopped fitting.

tolerance_rule.formula: tolerance = roundup(observed_band, 10000) + 10000, with a floor of 15000; budget = measured + tolerance
tolerance_rule.measured_at: the `measured` value of every entry is the HIGHEST draw this lane observed, not a single run. Pinning the highest draw is what keeps ordinary noise from producing a red row.
tolerance_rule.noise: BOTH CAMPAIGNS ARE SEEDED NOW, and the residual is measured rather than assumed. The original cause was exact: every campaign drew fresh signing keypairs per run (Keypair::new() in the successor bootstrap; Keypair::new() and Pubkey::new_unique() in the ProgramTest fast lane), which changes how many iterations find_program_address needs for an off-curve bump, and each iteration is one sol_create_program_address syscall at 1,500 CU. Every delta measured between runs was an exact multiple of 1,500 (a handful of +-4 residuals aside), which is what made the diagnosis a measurement rather than a story. tier 4 is now band 0 on every row, proven over four runs of one compiled binary. tier 1 is NOT: 82 of its 101 transactions are byte-identical across two seeded runs at one revision and 19 are not, because A KEYPAIR SEED ONLY SEEDS KEYPAIRS -- the founding ladders carry expiry slots derived as finalized_slot + 500,000 and lookup tables derived from [authority, recent_slot], and those move with when the campaign happens to run. See CU_BUDGETS.md.
tolerance_rule.measured_bands: SEEDED, tier 1, two campaigns at 5465341 on 2026-08-27 with one seed digest and one set of ELFs: 14 of the 24 enforced rows are band 0, including every per-role activation, Found31 and its rollback case, the infrastructure profile init, the non-terminal DCLTPCB1 refusal, the second projected-Custody prestate and both DCLTPCA1 cases. The other 10 are the two founding ladders and their stages: dcltgmf1-whole 9,004; its stages 1,500 / 2 / 2 / 1,500; dcltpcb1-whole 24,000; its stages 6,000 / 4,500 / 1,500; the reordered-tail refusal 24,000. UNSEEDED, which is what this file's pins were written against and what a real founder still pays: DCLTGMF1 58,494, DCLTPCB1 51,005 across campaigns and 79,500 within ONE campaign, the reordered-tail refusal 55,503, per-role activation 1,500-9,000. tier 4 seeded: 0 on every row over four runs; unseeded it spanned 24,000 on the founding case and 6,000 on the substituted-ProgramData refusal, which six runs had not bounded.
tolerance_rule.what_this_buys_and_what_it_does_not: A tolerance that exceeds the band cannot also catch a regression smaller than the band. On tier 1's founding transactions the band is 58,494-79,500, so a +30,000 regression to DCLTGMF1 is NOT reliably caught by its whole-transaction budget and this file will not pretend otherwise. What IS caught: any structural regression larger than the tolerance, on any draw; and — the thing W1f actually asked for — the moment the transaction gets close enough to the 1,400,000 ceiling that the budget can no longer be written down. The teeth at the 30,000 scale live on the entries whose measured band is zero or near it (Found31, the Found31 rollback case, the infrastructure profile init, the DCLTPCB1 non-terminal refusal) and on the tier-4 fast lane, which is also the one that runs pre-campaign.
tolerance_rule.how_to_shrink_it: TAKEN, 2026-08-27. dclutch-local-successor-bootstrap run takes --keypair-seed <64 hex> behind a loopback-only refusal, and programs/dclutch-core-sbf/tests/found_program_test.rs and programs/dclutch-custody-sbf/tests/program_test.rs derive their fixture keys from documented preimages. What remains is NOT a keypair: the tier-1 founding ladders hash slot- and clock-derived material into addresses, so shrinking those rows further means making the campaign's expiry and lookup-table inputs a function of the seed rather than of the wall clock. That is a change to what the campaign SUBMITS, not to how it draws keys, and it is not obviously worth it: the world is still as noisy as it ever was and a founding is exactly where a real founder pays that noise too.

budgets.transaction: found the Market atomically: Lock, Found, Realize, Claims, Open (DCLTGMF1)
budgets.provenance: THE transaction this lane exists for. Five stages in one rollback domain: Custody LockHoardAndCloseSource, Core Found-and-permit, Custody RealizeAndClose, Claims FoundingV5, Core Open LAST. Measured 1,184,132 at cd05331 (84.6% of the ceiling) and 1,278,747 at d9f79bb (91.3%) in ONE EVENING from other lanes' changes to Core, Claims and Trading, which is the growth W1f named as urgent and unowned. The pin is the higher of the two 2026-08-27 draws; the lower draw at 3b0c588 was 1,220,253. Remaining ceiling headroom from the pin is 121,253 CU, 8.7%, AND SHRINKING. The budget is 51,253 CU below the ceiling: when this transaction's measured value rises past 1,330,000 the budget can no longer be written at this tolerance and the evaluator refuses the file. That refusal is the point. This number's job is not to bless 1,278,747.

Re-pinned by the SEED lane at bbfc53a, on a SEEDED fixture: programs/dclutch-core-sbf/tests/found_program_test.rs now derives its payer and its vault addresses from a fixed checked-in seed instead of Keypair::new() and Pubkey::new_unique().
